## Distance to financial independence

At a 25× multiple of the last 12 months' spending, invested assets cover **5.8%** of the target.
Each euro cut from yearly spending lowers the target by 25 euros. At this stage, spending moves the FI date more than market returns do.

---

<details>
<summary>How these numbers are made</summary>

- **Bank:** current account and credit-card exports, classified by the same rules as my [ExpensesParser](/project) dashboard. Credit-card settlements are de-duplicated against card lines. Transfers to investments count as *saved*.
- **Portfolio:** the Trade Republic transaction export (up to 2026-08-21) replayed into daily holdings, valued at Xetra/Frankfurt closing prices. 25% of invested value (mostly bonds) has no price feed and is carried at cost.
- **Money-weighted return** is the XIRR of external deposits and withdrawals against the end value.
- **FI progress** counts the Trade Republic account plus pension and savings plans; it excludes current-account cash.
- Privacy: only ratios and percentages are published, no amounts.
</details>
